title: Select D&D SRD source version and import policy
description: Decide which D&D SRD version the initial complete pack targets and document import scope, exclusions, attribution, generated artifact policy, and whether older/newer SRD baselines are separate packs.
acceptance_criteria:
- Target SRD version is explicitly selected.
- Import scope is documented.
- Attribution and license metadata are specified.
- Any excluded categories are documented.
- Decision is recorded in docs or ADR form.
close_reason: Decision recorded in ADR 0005; ships 5.1 and 5.2 as separate base packs.
